basic_info.description: Awesome New Price. This two bedroom, pride of ownership residence, has lots of upgrades, a comfortable floor plan with separated ensuite bedrooms, high end finishes and Two Balconies. The residence finishes include: wood flooring, new paint, new carpet, lots of closets, closet systems, large slider doors to the balconies and air conditioning. The chef's kitchen has Studio/Becker cabinets, stainless steel appliances, gas range and granite counters. A large deeded self parking spot and extra large deeded storage area on the same floor complete the residence. The Lansing is a boutique building with a designer lobby, a private gym with adjoining sun deck and a large roof deck terrace with panoramic skyline views, a BBQ area and a lounging area. Built on bedrock. Live in San Francisco's newest and most dynamic neighborhood. Live walking distance to the waterfront, nightlife, the Giants ballpark, Chase Center, the financial district, the Salesforce Transit Center, tech stops and more. Walk to work and walk to play. Live it Up in South Beach, on Rincon Hill-the place to be.
